purpose: Reuse the durable EAzami Cirsium nipponicum genome-derived Compositae1061 locus pack as the East-Asian sequence-reference layer for aza3 R1B-0, without duplicating or re-deriving its 180 strict loci.
biological_context: natural Ulleung Island plant used for the 2024 nuclear genome study
aza3_use: intersect with focal C. sieboldii recovered Compositae1061 loci
measure pairwise sequence compatibility on identical locus IDs
provide an East-Asian sequence anchor before full chromosome-reference localization
prohibited_inferences: chromosome-coordinate concordance from sequence identity alone
next_gate: Whole-genome coordinate localization against C. heterophyllum, C. dissectum and C. nipponicum remains required for the final reference-transfer decision.
